<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h1 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">The Kite House</h1><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">Our Kitesurfing Guest House is located directly on the main kitesurfing beach, just next to the local fishing village of Punta Chame.<br>We are open yearly from December until April and feel the best way to experience Punta Chame and the surrounding area is by staying for a few nights. <br>We therefore have a minimum stay of 5 Nights and offer packages best suited for your perfect kitesurf holiday.</p>
</div>

    <h4 id="monday">Monday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Locally caught Fish with Rice, Salad and Vegetables<br>Dinner: Homemade Burger Night or Chicken Wraps with side dishes</p>
<h4 id="tuesday">Tuesday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Burritos with Patacones<br>Dinner: Dinner at a French Restaurant "Casa Amarilla"</p>
<h4 id="wednesday">Wednesday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Ceviche &amp; Chicken with Rice, Salad and Vegetables<br>Dinner: Authentic Dinner at a locals backyard</p>
<h4 id="thursday">Thursday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Locally caught Langostino or Camarones with Rice, Salad and Vegetables<br>Dinner: Pizza night or Spaghetti Bolognese / Vegetarian with Feta, Olives, Tomatoe Salad</p>
<h4 id="friday">Friday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Ceviche &amp; Meat with Rice, Salad and Vegetables<br>Dinner: Freshly caught Fish or Prawn Scewers on the BBQ </p>
<h4 id="saturday">Saturday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Chicken Wraps with French Fries from "Happycorner"<br>Dinner: Stuffed Peppers with Mashed Potatoes or Chicken Curry with Garlic Naan</p>
<h4 id="sunday">Sunday</h4>
<p>Lunch: Ceviche &amp; Pork with Rice, Salad and Vegetables<br>Dinner: Homemade Lasagne</p>
<h4 id="please-note">Please Note</h4>
<p>Please note this is not a fixed menu and can vary.
We have vegetarian alternatives, and can adapt meals to allergies. Please let us know when booking if you have other diatary requirements. </p>

      <section id="transfers" class="Index-page"  data-collection-id="60ddc799d18ed32845e5a69a" data-parallax-id="60ddc799d18ed32845e5a69a" data-edit-main-image="Background">
        
        <div class="Index-page-content ">
          <div class="sqs-layout sqs-grid-12 columns-12" data-type="page" data-updated-on="1754416000215" id="page-60ddc799d18ed32845e5a69a"><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-12 span-12"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_2251"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;">How to get there</h3><p style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;" class="">The closest airport to the Panama Kite House is Panama Tocumen International Airport (PTY) or for Canadians there is a connection to the even closer Rio Hato (RIH) Airport. From there the easiest way is to get picked up by our team, but you can also take a Bus or rental car. If you arrive from other places within Panama or Costa Rica and need a transfer or information on how to get to us, send us a quick message.</p>
</div>




















  
  



</div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_4834" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_4834"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_7562"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Transfer</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We provide airport transfers. The drive is about 1.5-3h depending on traffic and you can also request the driver to stop at the Panama Canal or other places.<br><em>Cost: $100 one way<br>Additional person: +$10 | additional stop: +$20</em></p>
</div>




















  
  



</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_5438" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_5438"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_8773"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Bus</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">The authentic way to travel Panama. You will need to get to Albrook bus terminal in Panama City and take a bus to Chame. Once in Chame, take a local bus into Punta Chame. <br><em>Total time: 4-5h, Cost: About $10</em></p>
</div>




















  
  



</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-4 span-4"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-spacer spacer-block sized vsize-1" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.spacer/6ede5407-a94a-4d6b-b6c2-8feb83eabc85_1292/website.components.spacer.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.spacer" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_6436" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_6436"><div class="sqs-block-content">&nbsp;</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-border-radii="&#123;&quot;topLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;topRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomLeft&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;,&quot;bottomRight&quot;:&#123;&quot;unit&quot;:&quot;px&quot;,&quot;value&quot;:0.0&#125;&#125;" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1625147291811_10155"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Rental Car</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">If you decide to rent a car, please see the map below for the location of the Kite House. You can also find us on Google Maps and Waze under Panama Kite House. <br>We have parking available on the property.</p>
</div>
